text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and C after large gains felt rewarding, but I should weigh a sale against the position’s future prospects, not just the pleasure of locking in gains.","I waited through repeated account declines, then sold Stock D and E at steep losses; I should review weakening holdings sooner and follow a plan rather than let regret keep me from acting.","Buying Stock C again and later selling part at a strong gain shows why I need consistent position-size and exit rules, so frequent checking and loss aversion do not drive impulsive trades."]}
